build_anonymizer_stage_flow: build a PrivateComputationAnonymizerStageFlow enum to define CREATED and ANONYMIZER stage order for routine advertisers
create_anonymizer_stage: create an ANONYMIZER stage with initialized, started, completed, and failed status mappings as a joint stage
create_created_stage: create a CREATED stage with initialization, start, completion, and failure status mappings as a non-joint stage
run_get_stage_service: run get_stage_service to return an AnonymizerStageService for the ANONYMIZER stage or default service otherwise
review_stage_flow_order: review the _order_ attribute to verify CREATED then ANONYMIZER stage execution sequence
